caption: 「Super Idiot！超級智障！」
scene: A crowded press conference backstage, a trendy young streamer in a streetwear hoodie laughing into a selfie stick phone, flashbulbs exploding, a dazed man in a navy blue hoodie with round glasses standing frozen at the edge of a curtain, harsh white light, chaotic energy

caption: 「技術召集人？超級智障吧？」
scene: Wide shot of a press conference hall, the streamer standing up in the crowd pointing his phone at the stage, journalists turning their heads and snickering, the man in the navy hoodie sitting at a long table under blinding flash photography, humiliating atmosphere

caption: 「十點零七分，這台投影機會當機。」
scene: Close-up of the man in the navy hoodie calmly raising his wrist to check a watch, faint smug smiles and eye-rolling reporters in the blurred foreground, a small glowing cyan hologram girl floating by his shoulder with a worried pout, dim stage lighting

caption: 「啪」——投影機黑了，全場愣住。
scene: The projector screen going black, a staff member frantically slapping the machine, the streamer's confident grin cracking into shock, the man in the navy hoodie still seated calmly, dramatic spotlight, stunned crowd silhouettes

caption: 「這是舊影片，換個標題而已。」
scene: Two identical fire videos playing side by side on a big screen, the man in the navy hoodie standing and pointing with a laser pointer, reporters leaning forward with wide eyes, the glowing cyan hologram girl grinning beside him, cool blue projection glow

caption: 「多花三十秒，就答得出來。」
scene: The streamer's face turning pale and green, his phone trembling in his hand, live chat scrolling wildly on his screen, journalists erupting into applause and camera flashes, the man in the navy hoodie lowering the microphone with a calm smile, triumphant lighting

caption: 「三天後，秀蘭嬤會接到一通電話。」
scene: Quiet backstage corner, the man in the navy hoodie leaning against a wall with clenched fists and reddened eyes, the small glowing cyan hologram girl floating close with a somber expression, soft warm light through a window, an elderly grandmother's floral apron faintly reflected in glass

caption: 「註冊 IP，跟幻鏡科技同網段。」
scene: The man in the navy hoodie frozen mid-step at a doorway, sunlight streaming in, the glowing cyan hologram girl whispering urgently by his ear, a tall man in a white suit with a flawless waxy face looming as a faint shadow reflection in the glass, ominous tension
